subject: rapunzel_tower_v2
summary: A tall, tapered, ivy-covered stone tower that flares under a round timber-framed chamber. A lattice-railed balcony ring sits at the chamber base, and arched windows, a central arched opening and flower boxes sit on the walls. A steep scalloped purple conical roof caps the chamber, with a small arched window, a ball-and-spike finial and a pot-shaped ornament on the roof edge. A smaller conical turret sits behind the roof on the back left.

tower_shaft.where: Base of the build, from the ground up to the chamber's underside.
tower_shaft.notes: Tall tapered stone column, flared at top, ivy-covered.

chamber.where: Sits on top of the shaft, under the roof cone.
chamber.notes: Round timber-framed room, widest storey, sits on the shaft.

roof_cone.where: Caps the chamber, rising from the eave to the finial.
roof_cone.notes: Steep scalloped conical roof, eaves overhang the chamber.

side_turret.where: Behind the main roof, on the back left of the chamber.
side_turret.notes: Small conical turret with its own pointed roof, set behind.

balcony.where: Ring at the chamber's base, between the shaft top and the windows.
balcony.notes: Projecting lattice-railed ring on brackets, proud of the walls.

chamber_window.where: Row of arched windows in the chamber wall, above the balcony and under the eave.
chamber_window.notes: Narrow arched windows set back into the timber-framed wall.

arched_opening.where: Centre of the front wall, between the windows, under the eave.
arched_opening.notes: Arched opening set back under the eave, flanked by flower boxes.

flower_box.where: Two planters under the roof eave, either side of the central opening.
flower_box.notes: Flower boxes proud of the wall under the eave.

roof_window.where: Small arched window in the upper cone, below the finial.
roof_window.notes: Small arched window set back in the upper cone.

spire_finial.where: Ball and spike on the very tip of the cone, above the roof window.
spire_finial.notes: Ball finial with a thin spike on the apex.

eave_ornament.where: Right edge of the roof, above the balcony and beside the chamber windows.
eave_ornament.notes: Small pot-shaped ornament standing on the roof edge.

roof_dormer.where: On the upper left flank of the roof cone, between the side turret and main spire.
roof_dormer.notes: Small pointed dormer with a tiny window, projecting from cone flank.

verify_notes: Missing small pointed roof dormer on cone's left flank; rest matches.
